jukebox_player.label: Jukebox player
jukebox_player.description: The player that Subsonic clients control in jukebox mode. Leave empty to disable jukebox mode.

app_password.label: Subsonic password for {0}
app_password.description: Use this password, together with the Music Assistant username, to log in from a Subsonic client. The server address is the Music Assistant address.

regenerate_passwords.label: Regenerate all Subsonic passwords
regenerate_passwords.description: Issue new Subsonic passwords for every user. Clients that use the old passwords stop working until they are updated.

manifest.description: Expose the Music Assistant library through the (Open)Subsonic API, so Subsonic clients can browse it and play on a Music Assistant player in jukebox mode.
